songs.title: Bone and Iron V2

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(male low guttural growl)
RISE!
(female brutal scream, heavy guitar chugs)
Rattle of bones in the fog!
Zombies crawl out of the bog!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Skeletons rise from the dirt!
Rotting flesh, blood on my shirt!
Witches chanting black magic in the dark!
I am the nightmare, I am the spark!
Iron blades, clattering teeth!
Demons waiting underneath!
Pack your curses! Bring your horde!
I am the hammer! I am the sword!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
Bones crack! (Male: BREAK!)
Spells fail! (Male: FALL!)
Monsters crawl! (Male: BLEED!)
I conquer them all!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male backing growl, driving metal beat)
Tear through the bone, tear through the iron!
Set the whole graveyard on fire!
Witches and demons, zombies and dread!
I am the ruler of all the undead!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream)
Zombie horde clawing my skin!
Curse of the witch won't let them in!
Skeletons shatter to dust!
Fangs cut through armor and rust!
Flame in my eyes! Venom and rage!
Lock all your monsters inside of a cage!
Not gonna break! Not gonna bow!
Look at who owns the graveyard now!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
Bones crack! (Male: BREAK!)
Spells fail! (Male: FALL!)
Monsters crawl! (Male: BLEED!)
I conquer them all!

[Bridge]
(crushing electronicore breakdown, heavy double-bass)
(male deep roar)
CRUSH THE UNDEAD!
(female brutal scream)
Black magic dies tonight!
Shatter the skull! Tear out the heart!
(male and female dual shout)
RIP THEM APART!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male backing growl)
Tear through the bone, tear through the iron!
Set the whole graveyard on fire!
Witches and demons, zombies and dread!
I am the ruler of all the undead!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals)
Tear through the bone, tear through the iron!
Set the whole graveyard on fire!
Witches and demons, zombies and dread!
I am the ruler of all the undead!

[Outro]
(fading downtuned guitar chugs)
(female whispered scream)
Dust and ash...
(male deep echo)
Nothing remains.
(female brutal scream)
I BROKE THE CHAINS!

songs.title: Frizzed and Fractured V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, deathcore breakdowns, aggrotech, 155 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic chorus, distorted supersaw synth, explosive electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(heavy electronic chugs, blast beat)
(male deep guttural roar)
WITCH IN THE TREES!
(female brutal scream)
SPARK AND BURN!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Battle in the graveyard! Witches in the sky!
Green spell flying! Hit me in the eye!
Zap through the shoulder! Static in the air!
What the hell happened to my fur and hair?!
Sizzling! Smoking! Standing end to end!
How am I supposed to fight and defend?!
It’s purple! It’s frizzy! It’s glowing in the dark!
Every single follicle shooting off a spark!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Spells crack! (Male: HIT!)
Sparks fly! (Male: FRIED!)
Look at my coat! (Male: RUINED!)
Where can I hide?!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy metalcore beat)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream)
Try to lick it down, but the static makes it stick!
Other wolves staring! Man, they’re gonna talk quick!
Alpha looks over! Snickers in the fog!
I look like a neon, electrified dog!
It was a surprise attack! She sneaked up behind!
Now I’ve got the ugliest coat you’ll ever find!
Witch laughing loud up on her broomstick seat!
I’m gonna tear her down and make the job complete!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Spells crack! (Male: HIT!)
Sparks fly! (Male: FRIED!)
Look at my coat! (Male: RUINED!)
Where can I hide?!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass)
Zombies in front of me, skeletons behind!
Trying to ignore that I’m losing my mind!
I charge through the horde with a purple glowing mane!
Every monster laughing at my static electricity pain!
I snap three necks just to cover up the shame!
Blaming the witch! Yeah, she’s the one to blame!
Next time a curse comes flying through the night,
I’m dodging the spell so my fur stays tight!

[Bridge]
(crushing deathcore breakdown, heavy double-bass)
(male deep roar)
LOOK AT HER COAT!
(female brutal scream)
DON'T LOOK AT ME!
(male deep roar)
ELECTRIC SHEEP!
(female screams with immense rage)
I’LL KILL YOU ALL FOR LAUGHING AT ME!
SHATTER THE BROOM! TEAR OUT THE SPARK!
(male and female dual shout)
DIE IN THE DARK!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(heavy downtuned 7-string chugs, screeching acid synths)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Witch drops down! Trying for a second shot!
Not this time! I’m taking everything you’ve got!
I jump through the magic! Ignore the purple glow!
Rip off her hat with an iron-claw blow!
Now who’s laughing? Who’s running the fight?
Even with bad hair, I rule the night!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals)
Frizzed and fractured under blood-red skies!
Is it worse that my fur looks a total mess?
Or that the whole pack saw me take the hit?
I’m dying of pure humiliation and stress!

[Outro]
(fading downtuned guitar chugs)
(female whispered growl)
Witch is dead... spell is broken...
(male low echo growl)
Fur still frizzy...
(female brutal final scream)
NOBODY SAY A WORD!

songs.title: Bone Chewer V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, aggrotech, dark electro, synthwave metal, deathcore breakdowns, 155 bpm, 4/4 meter, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic female chorus, distorted supersaw synths, acid sequences, explosive electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(screeching acid synths, heavy blast beat)
(male low guttural growl)
CRUNCH THE SKULL!
(female brutal scream)
I WANT THE MARROW!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Skeletons charging out of the dark!
Clattering teeth and a glowing spark!
Most wolves run, but I start to grin!
That’s a walking snack rack coming on in!
Rip off the arm! Snap off the thigh!
Chew through the marrow under the sky!
Crispy and crunchy! Best fight of my life!
Better than witches! Better than strife!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
Snap the rib! (Male: CRUNCH!)
Chew the joint! (Male: BITE!)
Shatter the skull! (Male: SNACK!)
We own the night!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy synth-metal beat)
Rip and tear and eviscerate the night!
Nothing beats the crunch of a skeleton bone!
Best treat in the graveyard, crisp and clean!
I’m taking every femur back to my throne!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream)
Then comes a slime demon out of the bog!
Toxic green ooze floating over the fog!
Got to sink my teeth in to tear it apart!
Grossest damn thing that I ever had to start!
Sticky and sour! Tastes like rot!
Gagging mid-battle on a gelatin clot!
Why do I have to bite this disgusting blob?!
I’m a wolf, not a trash can! I hate this job!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female panicked scream, male backing growl)
Sticky ooze! (Male: GROSS!)
Snot and bile! (Male: REEK!)
Bite it down! (Male: GAG!)
Make the demon bleed!

[Bridge]
(crushing electronicore breakdown, heavy acid bass synth)
(male deep roar)
TOXIC TASTE!
(female brutal scream)
GET IT OUT OF MY MOUTH!
(male deep roar)
NEED A BONE!
(female screams with immense rage)
SMASH ANOTHER SKELETON TO CLEAN MY TEETH!
SHATTER THE SPINE! RIP OUT THE SHIN!
(male and female dual shout)
CLEAN TASTE AGAIN!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(hyper-kinetic acid synth leads, downtuned 7-string chugs)

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy electronic bass)
Wiping off the slime on a patch of dead grass!
Back to the skeletons, moving in fast!
Snap! Crack! Pop! That’s the sound that I love!
Stars shining bright in the heavens above!
Eviscerate the ribcage, gnaw on the spine!
Every dry calcium bone is all mine!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Rip and tear and eviscerate the night!
Nothing beats the crunch of a skeleton bone!
Best treat in the graveyard, crisp and clean!
I’m taking every femur back to my throne!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals)
Rip and tear and eviscerate the night!
Nothing beats the crunch of a skeleton bone!
Best treat in the graveyard, crisp and clean!
I’m taking every femur back to my throne!

[Outro]
(fading acid synths, light bone-crunch sound effect cadence)
(female satisfied growl)
Slime is gone... mouth is clean...
(male low echo growl)
Good bone...
(female brutal final scream)
SAVE ME THE SKULL!

songs.title: Pelt and Polish V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, progressive metalcore, deathcore breakdown, mathcore, aggrotech, industrial metal, synthwave metal, dark electro, symphonic metalcore, 158 bpm, 4/4 meter, polyrhythmic chugs, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic female chorus, distorted supersaw synths, 303 acid sequences, orchestral strings, glitchy electronic percussion, full-power electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(symphonic darkwave strings, screeching 303 acid synth, blast beat)
(male deep guttural growl)
FLESH AND FUR!
(female brutal scream)
RUN FREE!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Midnight air exploding in my nose!
I can smell the pine, the rabbit, where the river flows!
Every nerve-end burning like a lightning rod!
Running through the forest like a savage little god!
Paws crashing down on the damp pine floor!
This is what the wild and the blood are for!
Flavors in the wind! Tastes like steel and rain!
Nothing in the world can match this feeling in my brain!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female screamed, male growl response)
Smell the earth! (Male: BREATHE!)
Feel the speed! (Male: RUN!)
Human life! (Male: DULL!)
Wolf has won!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy synth-metal beat)
I love the hunt, I love the wild, I love the open sky!
Nothing feels as real as when the wolf begins to cry!
But look at this coat—it’s matted, caked, and full of mud and burrs!
I wish it wasn’t such a nightmare taking care of fur!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Thorns in my flank! Pine sap in my tail!
Licking out a knot while I’m tracking on the trail!
Blood on my chest from the deer I caught!
Trying to groom it out is a losing battle fought!
Static in the wind making every single hair
Stick straight up in a tangled-up glare!
I’m a ferocious apex predator standing in the rain,
But this messy, knotty mane is a genuine pain!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female screamed, male growl response)
Smell the earth! (Male: BREATHE!)
Feel the speed! (Male: RUN!)
Human life! (Male: DULL!)
Wolf has won!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
I love the hunt, I love the wild, I love the open sky!
Nothing feels as real as when the wolf begins to cry!
But look at this coat—it’s matted, caked, and full of mud and burrs!
I wish it wasn’t such a nightmare taking care of fur!

[Interlude - Human Shift]
(glitchy synth arpeggios, soft piano, female clean vocals)
When I turn back human... it’s the one thing that I miss...
Sitting at the mirror... simple quiet bliss...
Running a brush through soft, clean hair...
Smelling like lavender... floating on air...
Smooth and shiny... bright and fine...
No pine sap or mud on this head of mine...

[Verse 3]
(female clean vocal transitioning to fast rap-scream, synthwave bass)
Yeah, the hairbrush feels amazing, and the silk feels nice!
But human taste and human smell come at a terrible price!
Food tastes like cardboard! Colors turn to gray!
I’m trapped inside a fragile shell that sleeps the night away!
No velocity! No power! No claws to tear the dark!
No electrical current shooting off a wild spark!
Give me the dirt! Give me the blood! Give me the raw delight!
I’ll trade a hundred hairbrushes to rule the woods tonight!

[Bridge - Symphonic Mathcore Shift]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female aggressive screamed delivery)
Human eyes are blind! Human ears are deaf!
Living in a cage until there’s nothing left!
I’d rather comb out a thousand thorny burrs
Than live a single quiet day that isn’t truly hers!

[Crushing Electronicore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal bass drop, screeching acid synths)
(male deep roar)
BRUSH THE FUR!
(female brutal scream)
OR TEAR THE THROAT!
(male deep roar)
DIRTY COAT!
(female screams with immense rage)
I’D RATHER BE A MESSY WOLF THAN A PERFECT HUMAN FREAK!
SNAP THE COMB! SHATTER THE MIRROR!
(male and female dual shout)
THE WOLF IS HERE!

[Guitar Solo & Synth Breakdown]
(hyper-kinetic technical metalcore guitar solo, heavy supersaw arpeggios)

[Verse 4]
(female fast metalcore delivery)
Back on four legs! Shake the mud right off my back!
Leading the charge at the front of the pack!
If a branch gets stuck, I’ll just bite it in two!
Got a million better things for my jaws to do!
Gnaw on a bone! Howl at the moon!
Human form can wait until another afternoon!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
I love the hunt, I love the wild, I love the open sky!
Nothing feels as real as when the wolf begins to cry!
But look at this coat—it’s matted, caked, and full of mud and burrs!
I wish it wasn’t such a nightmare taking care of fur!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat)
I love the hunt, I love the wild, I love the open sky!
Nothing feels as real as when the wolf begins to cry!
But look at this coat—it’s matted, caked, and full of mud and burrs!
I wish it wasn’t such a nightmare taking care of fur!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, wind ambient pads)
(female satisfied growl)
Messy, matted... but I am free...
(male low echo growl)
Wild forever...
(female brutal final scream)
HAND ME THE COMB LATER!

songs.title: Silk and Slaughter V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, progressive metalcore, deathcore breakdown, mathcore, aggrotech, industrial metal, synthwave metal, dark electro, symphonic metalcore, 160 bpm, 4/4 meter, polyrhythmic chugs, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic female chorus, distorted supersaw synths, 303 acid sequences, orchestral strings, glitchy electronic percussion, full-power electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(symphonic darkwave strings, screeching 303 acid synth, heavy double-kick drum roll)
(male deep guttural growl)
LOOK AT THE STAIN!
(female brutal scream)
YOU TEAR MY SILK, YOU DIE!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Sinking my teeth in a demon’s throat!
Tastes like brimstone, ash, and goat!
No juice! No flavor! Just dry black dust!
Biting a witch is a pure disgust!
Tastes like copper and stale old mold!
Where’s the fresh meat out in the cold?!
Sulfur and ozone stink up the air!
Nothing smells good in a monster’s lair!
Give me a deer, give me something sweet!
This demonic garbage ain't fit to eat!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
Dry ash! (Male: TASTELESS!)
Stale rot! (Male: FOUL!)
No scent! (Male: DISGUSTING!)
Hear the wolf howl!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy synth-metal beat)
None of these monsters taste good at all!
Their blood smells like acid and ash on the wall!
I was handling the fight, keeping my grace—
Until somebody splattered black sludge on my face!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Swinging at a gargoyle, fast and slick!
CRACK! Goes my thumbnail right to the quick!
My fresh pink polish! My pointed claw!
Snapped right off on a stone-cold jaw!
Are you kidding me?! That took two hours to file!
Now my manicure is ruined in a bloody pile!
My finger is throbbing! The shape is destroyed!
Now I am genuinely, deeply annoyed!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
Nail snapped! (Male: BROKEN!)
Claw split! (Male: PAIN!)
Pure rage! (Male: BERSERK!)
Go completely insane!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
None of these monsters taste good at all!
Their blood smells like acid and ash on the wall!
I was handling the fight, keeping my grace—
Until somebody splattered black sludge on my face!

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass, glitchy synths)
Look down at my outfit—my favourite lace dress!
A big greasy patch of dark purple mess!
It’s on the white collar! It’s caked on the sleeve!
This stain won't wash out, I can't even believe!
I paid full price for this vintage silk coat!
Now I’m ripping the spine straight out of your throat!
I don't care about the curse or the dark magic spell!
YOU RUINED MY CLOTHES, NOW I’M SENDING YOU TO HELL!

[Interlude - Glitchy Electronic Break]
(hyper-kinetic 303 acid synth solo, soft piano accents, female breathless rant)
Inspect the hem... ruined...
Look at the cuff... ruined...
My nail is bleeding... my coat is black...
There is no way in hell you're walking back...

[Bridge - Symphonic Metalcore Escalation]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
I can tolerate the stink, I can tolerate the grime!
I can tolerate a foul-tasting demon every time!
But break my acrylics and ruin my threads?!
I won't stop clawing till every monster is dead!

[Crushing Deathcore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal bass drop, screeching industrial synths)
(male deep roar)
SHE'S RAGING OUT!
(female brutal scream)
FULL ANNIHILATION MODE!
(male deep roar)
NO MERCY!
(female screams with immense berserker rage)
EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU IS GOING TO PAY FOR MY DRESS!
RIP THEM TO SHREDS!
(male and female dual shout)
TOTAL DESTRUCTION!

[Guitar & Synth Solo]
(shredding technical metalcore guitar solo, heavy supersaw arpeggios, blast beats)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Tearing through witches! Smashing through skulls!
Blood-splattered fury that never turns dull!
I’m a hurricane of claws in a ruined lace skirt!
Making every single monster in the graveyard hurt!
You don't mess with my style, you don't touch my clothes!
That's the one rule that every demon now knows!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
None of these monsters taste good at all!
Their blood smells like acid and ash on the wall!
I was handling the fight, keeping my grace—
Until somebody splattered black sludge on my face!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
None of these monsters taste good at all!
Their blood smells like acid and ash on the wall!
I was handling the fight, keeping my grace—
Until somebody splattered black sludge on my face!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, wind ambient pads)
(female out-of-breath growl)
Monsters dead... ruined dress...
(male low echo growl)
Need a nail salon...
(female brutal final scream)
AND A VERY STRONG LAUNDRY DETERGENT!

songs.title: Neon Frequency V2
songs.style: electronicore, heavy metalcore, progressive metalcore, deathcore breakdown, mathcore, aggrotech, industrial metal, synthwave metal, dark electro, symphonic metalcore, 162 bpm, 4/4 meter, polyrhythmic chugs, heavy double-kick drums, blast beats, downtuned 7-string chugs, aggressive female screamed vocals, sparse male guttural growls, soaring melodic female chorus, distorted supersaw synths, 303 acid sequences, glitchy electronic percussion, full-power electronic metal mix
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(piercing high-frequency ultrasound sweep, screeching 303 acid synth, heavy double-kick drum roll)
(male deep guttural growl)
CUT THE SIGNAL!
(female brutal scream)
MY EARS ARE BLEEDING!

[Verse 1]
(female screamed, fast technical delivery)
Stepping into the abandoned subway line!
Neon lights flickering along the spine!
High-pitched ringing bouncing off the concrete wall!
Cyber-witch set a trap inside the transit hall!
Frequency whining at twenty-thousand hertz!
My sharp wolf hearing is exploding where it hurts!
Covering my ears, but the sound cuts through!
Can’t track a scent when the audio’s a nightmare brew!
Piercing squeals echoing through every drain!
A high-decibel assault directly on my brain!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
High pitch! (Male: DEAFENING!)
Earache! (Male: RINGING!)
Sonic trap! (Male: AGONY!)
Stop the cyber-singing!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing, heavy synth-metal beat)
Blasted by the neon frequency down in the dark!
Every high note piercing like an iron spark!
I can’t use my hearing, so I’m hunting by the bass!
I will track the subwoofer and rip off her face!

[Verse 2]
(female aggressive metalcore scream, heavy 7-string chugs)
Mechanical spiders drops down from the beam!
Speaker horns blasting out an ultrasound scream!
I trip over copper wire coiled on the floor!
Sparks flying everywhere, locking every door!
Cyber-witch laughing through an amp stack grid!
Thinks she trapped the wolf girl, thinks I can be hid!
I don’t need my ears when the concrete vibrates!
I can feel the sub-woofer pulsing at the gates!

[Pre-Chorus]
(female shouted, male growl response)
High pitch! (Male: DEAFENING!)
Earache! (Male: RINGING!)
Sonic trap! (Male: AGONY!)
Stop the cyber-singing!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, male growl backing)
Blasted by the neon frequency down in the dark!
Every high note piercing like an iron spark!
I can’t use my hearing, so I’m hunting by the bass!
I will track the subwoofer and rip off her face!

[Interlude - Sub-Bass Calibration]
(glitchy electronic percussion, sub-bass pulse, female whispered clean vocal)
Close my eyes... filter out the high...
Follow the rumble where the low frequencies lie...
Sixty hertz thumping through the iron rail...
I found your speaker booth... your magic's gonna fail...

[Verse 3]
(female fast rap-scream, heavy 808 sub bass, industrial synth drops)
Following the cables running down the track!
Spike-knuckled gloves bringing violent attack!
Smashing every horn mounted on the stone wall!
Silencing the noise in the subway hall!
One by one, the high frequencies die!
No more static screaming under neon sky!
Just the heavy chug of my pounding heart!
Time to tear the cyber-witch completely apart!

[Bridge - Symphonic Metalcore Shift]
(progressive time-signature chugs, soaring orchestral strings)
(female frantic screamed delivery)
You thought my sensitive ears were my weakest spot!
Used your high-tech frequency to give it all you got!
But wolves adapt, wolves conquer, wolves overcome!
Now you're gonna face the sound of my war drum!

[Crushing Deathcore Breakdown]
(heavy double-bass, brutal bass drop, screeching acid synths)
(male deep roar)
SMASH THE AMPLIFIER!
(female brutal scream)
KILL THE AUDIO!
(male deep roar)
TOTAL SILENCE!
(female screams with immense berserker rage)
TEAR OUT THE SOUNDBOARD! CRUSH THE TRANSMITTER!
NO MORE RINGING IN MY HEAD!
(male and female dual shout)
DEAD QUIET!

[Guitar & Synth Solo]
(shredding technical metalcore guitar solo, hyper-kinetic supersaw arpeggios, blast beats)

[Verse 4]
(female fast aggressive delivery)
Kicking through the glass of the control booth door!
Cyber-witch cowering on the tile floor!
No more speakers, no more high-pitched pain!
Just raw wolf muscle running down the train!
I rip through the wiring, smash the monitor display!
This is how the neon nightmare ends today!

[Chorus]
(soaring melodic female vocal, full anthemic power)
Blasted by the neon frequency down in the dark!
Every high note piercing like an iron spark!
I can’t use my hearing, so I’m hunting by the bass!
I will track the subwoofer and rip off her face!

[Final Chorus]
(maximum aggression, dual screamed and soaring vocals, full blast beat acceleration)
Blasted by the neon frequency down in the dark!
Every high note piercing like an iron spark!
I can’t use my hearing, so I’m hunting by the bass!
I will track the subwoofer and rip off her face!

[Outro]
(fading heavy electronic guitar chugs, hum of quiet sub-bass)
(female satisfied growl)
Static gone... quiet at last...
(male low echo growl)
Peace in the dark...
(female brutal final scream)
NEVER PLAY THAT SONG AGAIN!
